basedOn: Tafhim al-Qur'an by Sayyid Abul A'la Maududi (introduction)

sections.title: Where and when it was revealed
paragraphs: Most scholars say Makkah, including reports from Ibn Abbas and 'A'ishah. Others say Madinah, because Anas (who lived in Madinah) said the Prophet ﷺ smiled and told them a surah had just been revealed. Maududi explains why Makkah is more likely: the Prophet ﷺ had already been shown the river of Al-Kawthar during the Night Journey, which happened in Makkah.

sections.title: The story behind it
paragraphs: It came at a very hard time. The Quraysh had turned against the Prophet ﷺ, and his followers were few and poor. Then his sons, Qasim and later 'Abdullah, died.

His enemies were happy about it. Al-'As ibn Wa'il said: "Leave him, he is cut off, he has no son. When he dies, no one will remember him." When his second son died, his own uncle Abu Lahab rushed to tell the others: "Muhammad has been cut off tonight."
Allah answered with this surah: He gave His Messenger great good, and it is his enemies who will be cut off.
Allah gave the Prophet ﷺ Al-Kawthar. Ibn Abbas said it means "abundant good", and this includes a river in Paradise.

The Prophet ﷺ described it: a river in Paradise with banks of gold, flowing over pearls, its water whiter than milk and sweeter than honey (At-Tirmidhi). On the Day of Judgement, his followers will come to drink from it (Muslim).
So pray to your Lord alone, and sacrifice animals in His name alone, not for any idol. This was the opposite of what the idol worshippers did.
The one who hates the Prophet ﷺ and his message is the one who is really cut off and forgotten.
His enemies thought that without sons, his name would die with him. But Allah made his name remembered all over the world, and people will follow his way until the Last Day.

sections.title: Di mana dan kapan surah ini turun
paragraphs: Sebagian besar ulama mengatakan di Makkah, termasuk riwayat dari Ibnu Abbas dan Aisyah. Ulama lain mengatakan di Madinah, karena Anas (yang tinggal di Madinah) bercerita bahwa Nabi ﷺ tersenyum lalu memberitahu mereka bahwa sebuah surah baru saja turun. Maududi menjelaskan mengapa Makkah lebih mungkin: Nabi ﷺ sudah diperlihatkan sungai Al-Kautsar ketika Isra' Mi'raj, yang terjadi di Makkah.

sections.title: Kisah di baliknya
paragraphs: Surah ini turun di masa yang sangat sulit. Kaum Quraisy memusuhi Nabi ﷺ, dan pengikut beliau sedikit dan miskin. Lalu putra-putra beliau, Qasim dan kemudian Abdullah, meninggal dunia.

Musuh-musuh beliau justru senang. Al-'Ash bin Wa'il berkata, "Biarkan saja dia, dia terputus, tidak punya anak laki-laki. Kalau dia mati, tidak ada yang akan mengingatnya." Ketika putra kedua beliau wafat, paman beliau sendiri, Abu Lahab, bergegas memberitahu yang lain, "Muhammad telah terputus malam ini."
Allah menjawab dengan surah ini: Dia memberi Rasul-Nya kebaikan yang sangat banyak, dan justru musuh-musuhnya yang akan terputus.
Allah memberi Nabi ﷺ Al-Kautsar. Ibnu Abbas berkata artinya "kebaikan yang sangat banyak", dan di antaranya adalah sebuah sungai di surga.

Nabi ﷺ menggambarkannya: sebuah sungai di surga yang tepinya dari emas, mengalir di atas mutiara, airnya lebih putih dari susu dan lebih manis dari madu (HR. At-Tirmidzi). Pada Hari Kiamat, umat beliau akan datang untuk minum darinya (HR. Muslim).
Maka shalatlah hanya untuk Tuhanmu, dan sembelihlah hewan kurban hanya dengan nama-Nya, bukan untuk berhala. Ini kebalikan dari apa yang dilakukan para penyembah berhala.
Orang yang membenci Nabi ﷺ dan ajarannya, dialah yang benar-benar terputus dan dilupakan.

Musuh-musuh beliau mengira tanpa anak laki-laki, nama beliau akan hilang bersamanya. Tetapi Allah membuat nama beliau diingat di seluruh dunia, dan manusia akan mengikuti ajaran beliau sampai Hari Akhir.
